rows.title: The `dragonfly` CLI — Kind packages (ADR-0095)
rows.summary: `dragonfly add <folder>` installs a kind package (`kinds/<name>/` with `kind.toml` `[package]`) in `<install>/kinds/` after loading it with every dialect it implements (`add_package`, `copy_dir` in `main.rs`); `loader()` adds `kinds/` of the current folder and `<install>/kinds` to `Loader.packages`.
body: `dragonfly add <folder>` installs a kind package (`kinds/<name>/` with `kind.toml` `[package]`) in `<install>/kinds/`
after loading it with every dialect it implements (`add_package`, `copy_dir` in `main.rs`); `loader()` adds
`kinds/` of the current folder and `<install>/kinds` to `Loader.packages`. The skeleton comes from `nuclear kind
new <name> -p <platform> -d <dialect>` (crates/nuclear-cli). Pending: installing from a repository with a pinned
version (plan 002 D6).

rows.title: The `dragonfly` CLI — Known limits
rows.summary: the repository where it was built.
body: - Generators normalize with `snake()` but do not validate identifiers (leading digit, reserved words).
- `--org` only in `new`; when `build` creates a missing app it uses `com.example`.
- Dialects and `packages/dragonfly` are found in the installation (`nuclear_dialect::install_dir()`), else in
the repository where it was built. The `dragonfly` dependency is a local path until it is on pub.dev.
- Flutter apps are built here with the Flutter commands; backend and web projects are built with `nuclear build .` and
run/install/test/check through the dialect's `[toolchain]` (`manifest()` still refuses non-flutter for the Flutter-only
paths). A fresh web project builds and type-checks (`tsc`), but `vite build`/`dragonfly run` need the react runtime's
bundling fix (Pending: Dragonfly web): rollup cannot resolve `react` from the `--install-links`ed `dragonfly-web`.

rows.title: The `dragonfly` CLI — Platforms and the manifest (ADR-0093)
rows.summary: `dragonfly new [-p mobile] [-d flutter] <name>`: a dialect alone gives its platform (`-d nestjs` is backend), a platform alone its default dialect; the name must be letters, digits and `_` and an option glued to it (`shop-p`) or a stray word (`backend` without `-p`) is refused with a hint…
body: `dragonfly new [-p mobile] [-d flutter] <name>`: a dialect alone gives its platform (`-d nestjs` is backend), a platform alone its default dialect; the name must be letters, digits and `_` and an option glued to it (`shop-p`) or a stray word (`backend` without `-p`) is refused with a hint (`platform_and_dialect`, `new_name`, `hint_for`); the dialect is loaded and must belong to the platform; mobile/flutter
is scaffolded, created and built as before; a backend dialect (`fastapi`, `nestjs`) gets `scaffold::backend_project`
(`config.nuc` + `config/project_config.nuc`) and a web/react project gets `scaffold::web_project` (`config.nuc` + `main.nuc`
with the router + `config/project_config.nuc`); both are built with `nuclear build .` and run through the dialect's
`[toolchain]`.
`build` also writes the project card `.nuclear/project.json` (`project::write_metadata`, spec/projects.md §1.1).
`manifest()` reads `config.nuc` through `Manifest::read` (`dragonfly(platform, dialect)`, `app(name)`); an app without
the line is still flutter (its `dragonfly check` reports N0303 with the line to add); a non-flutter project is
refused with the `nuclear build .` hint. `packages::template` writes the `dragonfly(...)` line first. Dialects live in
`dialects/<platform>/<dialect>/`; the loader finds them by name as before. Added by the platform session.

rows.summary: `build` adds the packages of the plugins `config.nuc` enables (`plugin_packages`, `project::enabled_plugins`) and removes those of plugins turned off (`sync_plugin_packages`, `build/app/.dragonfly_plugins`); a `local` package is found with `runtime_package` (installed `packages/`, else the…
body: `build` adds the packages of the plugins `config.nuc` enables (`plugin_packages`, `project::enabled_plugins`) and
removes those of plugins turned off (`sync_plugin_packages`, `build/app/.dragonfly_plugins`); a `local` package is
found with `runtime_package` (installed `packages/`, else the repository). Added by the platform session (ADR-0092).

rows.title: The `dragonfly` CLI — Rules
rows.summary: 1. The `nuclear` repository's `../crates/*` are used as a library by path (`nuclear-transpile::project`, `nuclear-dialect::Loader`, `nuclear-diag`); a missing transpiler feature is requested by message.
body: 1. The `nuclear` repository's `../crates/*` are used as a library by path
(`nuclear-transpile::project`, `nuclear-dialect::Loader`, `nuclear-diag`); a missing transpiler feature is
requested by message.
2. A Dragonfly project has only `.nuc` files; the CLI writes only into `build/` (the app and
`build/<name>.code-workspace`). Generators never overwrite a file.
3. Done = `cargo test` + `cargo clippy --all-targets` green and `./install.sh --no-vscode` at the root (the user
runs `~/.local/bin/dragonfly`; the VS Code workspace points to it).
4. A new command or behaviour updates `spec/flutter.md` §11 (and §3.1 for `config.nuc`), an ADR if it is a
decision, this tree, `docs/dragonfly/tutorial.md`, the `USAGE` of `main.rs` and the skeletons of `scaffold.rs`.
5. Colors, logos and animation only in a terminal; `NO_COLOR` respected; `check --json` through a pipe stays clean.
6. When the dialect changes (`@screen`, kinds, events), update the skeletons and test `new` + `g` + `check` +
`analyze` + `test`.

rows.title: Build pipeline
rows.summary: previous left `flutter analyze` with errors.
body: - Errors in `.nuc` → exit code 2 (`CODE_ERRORS`; editors do not repair). `run`, `test` and devices use `--no-pub`.
- `repair`: build+analyze → markers deleted + pub get + build → flutter clean + build, each step only if the
previous left `flutter analyze` with errors. Editors run it only when something fails.
- `explain`: maps a Dart error to its `.nuc` line; `--json` for editors.
- `watch` rebuilds the whole project and does not see dialect or defs changes (restart it).
- Flutter is found in `FLUTTER`, `FLUTTER_ROOT`, `.fvm/flutter_sdk` (project or above), the PATH, `~/fvm/default`
and typical folders (`find_flutter`); `NO_FLUTTER` explains where it looked.

rows.title: Build pipeline
rows.summary: `dragonfly build` leaves the app ready to compile and repeats nothing without changes (~40 ms): 1. Creates the app if missing; syncs `config.nuc` → pubspec and loads definitions BEFORE transpiling (packages.md).
body: `dragonfly build` leaves the app ready to compile and repeats nothing without changes (~40 ms):
1. Creates the app if missing; syncs `config.nuc` → pubspec and loads definitions BEFORE transpiling
([packages.md](packages.md)).
2. Transpiles the project; writes only what changed and deletes orphans (`.dart_tool/nuclear_files`).
3. `ensure_packages` (Dragonfly's own; with `@splash` also `flutter_native_splash`, detected by line prefix
`name:`), copies `out.copies`, `assets::write`.
4. `pub get` when `.dart_tool/package_config.json` is missing (after `flutter clean`) or the pubspec is newer
than the lock AND than `.dart_tool/nuclear_pub_get` (`pub get` does not touch an unchanged lock).
5. `build_runner --delete-conflicting-outputs` only if a file with `part` changed since
`.dart_tool/nuclear_build_runner` (`.g.dart` dates are useless: unchanged ones are not rewritten).
6. `flutter_native_splash:create` when the yaml or an image changed (`.dart_tool/nuclear_splash`). Removing
`@splash` deletes the yaml but leaves the native splash (`flutter_native_splash:remove` needs the yaml: run
it by hand first).
7. `write_line_map` → `build/app/.dart_tool/nuclear_lines.json` (`BuiltFile::lines`, for debuggers, ADR-0068).

rows.title: Build pipeline — VS Code workspace (`vscode.rs`)
rows.summary: `build/<name>.code-workspace`: Nuclear folder + Flutter app (the Flutter extension treats it as a normal project: devices, F5, hot reload, DevTools), tasks `dragonfly: watch/build/test/analyze` (no problem patterns: the LSP gives the errors; errors of closed `.nuc` files only show in the task…
body: `build/<name>.code-workspace`: Nuclear folder + Flutter app (the Flutter extension treats it as a normal
project: devices, F5, hot reload, DevTools), tasks `dragonfly: watch/build/test/analyze` (no problem patterns:
the LSP gives the errors; errors of closed `.nuc` files only show in the task terminal), launch
debug/profile/release with `preLaunchTask`, `dart.flutterSdkPath`. **Do not rename `"<name> (debug)"` nor its
`type: "dart"`**: the VS Code extension shows ▷ Run/Debug only if it exists and launches it by name. The tasks'
`command` is `current_exe()` (with `cargo run` it points to `target/debug`). Reload on save relies on
`dart.previewHotReloadOnSaveWatcher` (may cause a double reload with the extension's own; can be removed).

rows.title: Landing, header, help and colors (`landing.rs`)
rows.summary: removed by `./install.sh --uninstall`), then the page alone.
body: - `dragonfly` without arguments: the animation ONLY the first time (marker `$XDG_STATE_HOME/dragonfly/intro_seen`,
removed by `./install.sh --uninstall`), then the page alone. `dragonfly credits` (alias `author`): always the
full animation and the page with credits (Julian Molina, github.com/nodelorien, github.com/nuclearlang).
- ~11 s animation as a CONCEPT, not realistic: radioactive mushroom in ASCII, a wave of characters that fills the
screen and dissolves into `█▓▒░`, grass grows back and a dragonfly lands on a flower; then the page with the
NuclearLang and Dragonfly logos. After the wave, "WELCOME" (5-row letters) appears in negative, turns green
with "to NuclearLang · Dragonfly" and dissolves. In the grass scene the motto is written (`motto`): Spanish
if `LC_ALL`/`LC_MESSAGES`/`LANG` starts with `es` (localization data, allowed by ADR-0075/0082), else English.
- Only characters over the terminal background: no background colors (a test checks it), the theme's text color
in normal/bold/dim and few accents; fades are dissolves. The dragonfly is metallic purple (`metal`) with
radioactive green eyes; the NuclearLang symbol is drawn `ASPECT` (1.35) times wider to look round.
- The page stays alive until Enter (a thread reads stdin; Enter during the animation jumps to the page, except

rows.title: Landing, header, help and colors (`landing.rs`)
rows.summary: in `credits`; EOF only closes a complete page); a shine crosses the dragonfly every `SHINE_EVERY` (5 s); without a terminal stdin it ends by itself.
body: in `credits`; EOF only closes a complete page); a shine crosses the dragonfly every `SHINE_EVERY` (5 s);
without a terminal stdin it ends by itself.
- `header()`: before any command (also `-h`/`help`; not on the bare page nor `credits`), a 6-row header with
both small logos (`MINI`, `sign` radius 6), on stderr and only in a terminal.
- Output colors: `ok` green = done, `bad` red = error, `warn` yellow = warning/note, `cmd` blue = commands,
`name` purple = project/step names, `dim` = paths and details; `diagnostics()` colors transpiler errors; only if
stdout and stderr are terminals and no `NO_COLOR`. In `watch`, `dragonfly: transpiling|ready|errors` has no
color (the VS Code task looks for it).
- `usage()`: help with a width-1 symbol per section and command (⚙ build, ✿ new, ⚗ test...; only symbols in
common monospace fonts, checked with `fc-list :charset=`). Without a terminal, with `NO_COLOR` or below 80×23,
only the page.
- Review the animation without a terminal: `script -qc "stty cols 100 rows 30; dragonfly" /dev/null` captures
frames (split by `ESC[?2026h`); a PIL script turns them into images. The user has not yet checked the new
animation in a real terminal (`STATUS.md`).

rows.title: Packages, definitions and assets — `assets.rs` (ADR-0071)
rows.summary: `write` rewrites `assets:`/`fonts:`/`shaders:` under `flutter:` of the app's pubspec on every build (the rest is kept; keys recognized by 2-space indentation); `fonts` groups `assets/fonts/<Family>/` by the last word of the name and errors when two files match (`build` and `check` call it before…
body: `write` rewrites `assets:`/`fonts:`/`shaders:` under `flutter:` of the app's pubspec on every build (the rest is
kept; keys recognized by 2-space indentation); `fonts` groups `assets/fonts/<Family>/` by the last word of the
name and errors when two files match (`build` and `check` call it before writing). Tested with `flutter build
bundle` (FontManifest and shader).

rows.title: Packages, definitions and assets — `packages.rs` (ADR-0065–0070)
rows.summary: `build/app/pubspec.yaml` by editing lines; `flutter pub add/remove`; `build/app/.dragonfly_deps` = packages that come from config.nuc, so only those are removed; never removes Dragonfly's own, `OWN` + `PACKAGES`).
body: - `read` (sections from the dialect's `[project.manifest]`), `sync` (`app`/`environment` fields and packages →
`build/app/pubspec.yaml` by editing lines; `flutter pub add/remove`; `build/app/.dragonfly_deps` = packages
that come from config.nuc, so only those are removed; never removes Dragonfly's own, `OWN` + `PACKAGES`).

- `load_defs`: version from `pubspec.lock` → `~/.cache/nuclearlang/defs/dart/

/`; if missing,
`generate_defs` runs `dart run bin/defs.dart` of `tools/defs` with `--exclude` of the dialect's packages;
`Loader::add_defs`; writes `build/defs.lock`; skips packages the dialect knows.
- `add`/`remove` (`dragonfly flutter add|remove`, also `pub add|remove`): edit config.nuc with
`set_entry`/`remove_entry`, one entry per line; `add` rejects reserved packages
(`project::reserved_package`) before running flutter; `sync` never adds a reserved one.
- `ensure_config`: `check` and `build` create config.nuc if missing (name, description/version, third-party
packages of the app; those with a map, `path:`/`git:`, are left out). `template`: config.nuc of `new`.
`manifest()` takes the name from `app(name)`. `check` only uses cached definitions.

rows.title: Packages, definitions and assets — `packages.rs` (ADR-0065–0070)
rows.summary: Limits: only sections written one entry per line can be edited (a one-line section with entries errors, `block`); the pubspec is edited by lines (`set_yaml`/`yaml_get`), not with a YAML parser; versions are text (`"^2.2.3"`), no `path:`/`git:` yet.
body: Limits: only sections written one entry per line can be edited (a one-line section with entries errors,
`block`); the pubspec is edited by lines (`set_yaml`/`yaml_get`), not with a YAML parser; versions are text
(`"^2.2.3"`), no `path:`/`git:` yet. A package without `lib/<name>.dart` is described with every file of
`lib/`; types re-exported from another project package repeat (first wins). `devDependencies` have no
definitions. `generate_defs` prints a long command. `flutter add` runs two builds.
